content.value_statement: Incomplete design handoffs make supplier quotes and inspection planning inconsistent. This guide helps an AI assistant draft structured manufacturing documents for engineering review.
actual_capabilities: Guide BOM normalization with part numbers, quantities, materials, and finishes.
Draft drawing checklists covering tolerances, datums, surface finish, and revision control.
Structure supplier RFQ drafts with quantities, lead time questions, and quality requirements.
Draft first-article inspection plans linking critical dimensions to measurement methods.
Provide guidance for Markdown fabrication and assembly notes alongside exported design files.
limitations: Only a public guide is included; original scripts, extension source, and template files are absent.
Does not generate CAD or Gerber files or perform physical inspections.
PCB scope is inconsistent: the limitations exclude PCB assembly, while examples and answers describe PCB documents.
Outputs require engineering review and do not replace a quality management system or regulated manufacturing certification.

use_cases.title: Prepare a contract manufacturer handoff
use_cases.description: Organize BOM details, drawing checks, and unresolved specifications before sharing a mechanical design package.

use_cases.title: Standardize supplier quote requests
use_cases.description: Draft comparable RFQ packages with consistent quantities, revision references, lead time questions, and quality expectations.

use_cases.title: Plan first-article inspection
use_cases.description: Map supplied critical dimensions to proposed measurement methods and identify missing acceptance criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Start a handoff checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a mechanical manufacturing handoff checklist for [part]. List the design details you need before drafting supplier documents.

prompt_templates.title: Normalize a BOM
prompt_templates.prompt: Normalize this BOM: [BOM]. Include part number, revision, quantity, material, and finish. Mark missing values without inventing specifications.

prompt_templates.title: Draft comparable supplier RFQs
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft RFQs for [suppliers] using [approved BOM and drawing revisions]. Include [quantities], lead time questions, quality requirements, and unresolved technical questions.

prompt_templates.title: Build a traceable inspection plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Using [drawings, BOM, and critical dimensions], draft an FAI plan linking each characteristic to its source, acceptance criteria, and proposed measurement method. Flag gaps for engineering review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: connect inspection planning to design requirements.

output_examples.input: Prepare a handoff checklist for a machined bracket with a BOM that omits the finish.
output: BOM review: finish specification missing; request engineering confirmation.
Drawing review: verify tolerances, datums, surface finish, and revision identifiers.
RFQ draft: include requested quantity, lead time questions, and quality requirements.

output_examples.input: Draft an FAI entry for a bore specified as 10.00 mm with a tolerance of plus or minus 0.02 mm.
output: Proposed method: calibrated bore gauge, subject to quality engineer approval.
Open items: drawing reference, sampling requirement, and measurement conditions.

best_practices: Supply approved BOM and drawing revisions, including materials, finishes, quantities, and critical dimensions.
Mark missing specifications explicitly and resolve them with the responsible engineer.
Have engineering and quality staff approve RFQ and inspection drafts before supplier release.
anti_patterns: Treating generated documents as approved production instructions without engineering review.
Inventing tolerances, materials, finishes, or acceptance criteria that are absent from the design package.
Assuming the guide includes executable automation, CAD exports, or validated PCB assembly support.

faq.question: What is included in this package?
faq.answer: The package contains one public SKILL.md guide. Original scripts, extension source, and template files are not included.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide BOM data, drawing revisions, quantities, materials, finishes, critical dimensions, and supplier requirements. Identify missing or unapproved specifications.

faq.question: Does it generate CAD or Gerber files?
faq.answer: No. It guides document drafting; exported design files must come from your design tools.

faq.question: Does it support PCB assembly?
faq.answer: The guide conflicts on PCB scope. It shows PCB document examples but excludes PCB assembly in its limitations; use specialist review.

faq.question: Can it help plan first-article inspection?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides drafts that map critical dimensions to measurement methods. Quality engineers must validate acceptance criteria and inspection suitability.

faq.question: Is it suitable for regulated medical or aerospace production?
faq.answer: It does not provide regulated manufacturing certification or replace a quality management system. Specialist processes and approvals remain necessary.
